name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 6 Local Business Schema Markup
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
How to add LocalBusiness schema (JSON-LD) so search engines read the business details in a standard format.

# Key concepts
- Schema is invisible to visitors; it can enable rich results and improve click-through, though it is not a direct ranking factor.
- Use a specific subtype where possible (for example Plumber).
- Properties: name, address, telephone, openingHours, geo coordinates, url, logo, priceRange, aggregateRating (only if allowed and accurate).
- Generate with Google's Structured Data Markup Helper, a generator tool or a plugin; place in the head or before the closing body tag.
- Test with the Rich Results Test or Schema Markup Validator; watch GSC for structured data errors.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG rule: schema must match visible content (no hidden FAQs, no ratings not shown on the page).
- Summit city-service pages emit Plumber and FAQPage schema via the `summit-location-seo` mu-plugin; Pipeliners city pages carry Service schema with a LocalBusiness provider through OTTO ([Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas)).
